source: Fictional demo: I’m hosting Friendsgiving at my apartment. We haven’t picked a date. I want a potluck, but nobody has committed to a dish. We haven’t asked about allergies or dietary needs and don’t know the final headcount. Please help me prepare without assigning anyone work.
decisions: The organizer will host at their apartment.
suggestions: Use a potluck format, subject to the organizer’s review.
Ask participants to claim dishes after dietary needs are known.
questions: What allergies or dietary requirements should the menu accommodate?
What will each participant choose to bring?
What budget or contribution expectations should we agree?

items.title: Ask guests about allergies and dietary needs
Coordinate a main dish after dietary needs are known
